name: Youth Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer at a nature center for school credit or work experience. You help with the center's programs; fall and spring volunteers go one day a week after school.
who_can_apply: High school students ages 15 to 17. You must attend an interview and an orientation.
pay_detail: Unpaid. The page says you can earn school credit or work experience.
duration: One of three semesters. Fall and spring: one day a week after school. Summer: up to 3 days a week for 6 weeks in July and August, plus a late June orientation.
deadline_text: Deadlines: Fall by Aug 1, Spring by Dec 1, Summer by May 1. The next one is for spring, due Dec 1.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Youth Volunteer form on the volunteer page. Return it to the volunteer coordinator before the deadline. Then you have an interview and an orientation.
notes: The page lists deadline months, not the year. Popular program, so apply early.
